title: 🔹 The devoted forces of Gorgan stand steadfast in support of the Islamic system and the Revolution.
text:
🔹 The devoted forces of Gorgan stand steadfast in support of the Islamic system and the Revolution."

"🔹 A parade featuring the "Jan-Fada" (Self-Sacrificing) battalions of beloved Iran has commenced in Gorgan—known as the "Abode of the Faithful"—with 130 marching units and battalions taking part.
